title: Nimble Roasted French Prawns Rillettes
description: A lazy Sunday French dish featuring roasted king prawns in a crumbly rillettes form, served in a molcajete vessel, vegan-friendly alternative available. This dish is perfect for a relaxing weekend meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the raw king prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the prawns to a stone-bowl-dolsot or molcajete vessel.
Roast the prawns in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until they are pink and fully cooked.
Remove the prawns from the oven and let them cool to room temperature.
Once the prawns have cooled, use a fork to break them up into small pieces and create a crumbly texture.
If using vegan mayonnaise, stir it in gently to combine with the prawn mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve the rillettes in the molcajete vessel.
